entries.0c5ffcd9870486aa: This is the group's core business, wholesaling plywood, plywood secondary products, building materials and housing equipment to building materials retailers and building contractors. Its core company, JK Building Materials Co., Ltd., is the largest operating company, with revenue accounting for more than 10% of consolidated revenue. It is composed of 12 companies in total: 9 consolidated subsidiaries and 3 unconsolidated subsidiaries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥331,072 million.
entries.0f25119d44b5082e: Plywood Manufacturing and Wood Processing Business
entries.122ed69d9777a003: This business manufactures and sells ordinary plywood, structural plywood, long-length plywood and structural LVL “Keyram” made mainly from softwood, and also manufactures and sells laminated lumber and secondary plywood products, and processes and sells lumber. The core company is Keytec Co., Ltd., and the business consists of 10 consolidated subsidiaries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,342 million.
entries.3b08dd08e98101f2: Building contractors and other construction businesses
entries.3bf99ffc79fc8ff3: This is a category of businesses not included in the reportable segments. It includes a franchise business centered on management guidance for building materials retail stores (House Depot Japan Co., Ltd.), as well as construction work, warehousing and transport, materials brokerage, real estate leasing, travel and insurance agency, housing loan brokerage, the EC business and the management business. It consists of 21 companies in total: 13 consolidated subsidiaries, 4 non-consolidated subsidiaries and 4 affiliates. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥5,163 million.
entries.583eb3cdf21aeb89: This business retails plywood, secondary plywood products, building materials, housing equipment and other products. It is carried out by building materials sales companies in various regions, including Burken Marutama Co., Ltd. and Burken Higashi-Nihon Co., Ltd., and the network is expanding through business succession via M&A. It consists of 16 companies in total: 12 consolidated subsidiaries and 4 affiliates. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥51,241 million.
